'''Lelek''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Reports of her usage of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] were reached by [[Commander/Legends|commander]] [[Vilos]], stationed at the [[Mos Ila]] garrison, who was curious about the usage of the Force in a Jawa. He then sent an Imperial-allied individual to investigate the mysterious occurrence. After the individual subdued the Jawa, she was slain.

==Behind the scenes==
Lelek only reveals her name if the player chooses the Light Side option of taking her prisoner. The Dark Side option is to kill her there.
